english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for attacking, glaring, or acting viciously.
This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something in a threatening, fierce manner.
Use this when the aggressive manner is openly hostile, harsh, or threatening.
Use 惡狠狠咁 for visibly vicious or aggressively violent behaviour, rather than mere high intensity.
Use this when the delivery is especially fierce or aggressively hostile.

examples.english: They viciously berated the child until he cried.
examples.traditional: 佢惡狠狠咁鬧到個細路喊晒。
